fields.name: Size
fields.evidence: Not replicated. Toolkit GameEngine.dll constructor (+0x7D50C0): 0x41A00000 (20.0). ls::CameraSystem::UpdateOrthoCameraBehavior scales it by the zoom input and passes it to CameraComponent::SetOrtho as the half-width (height = size / aspect ratio).

fields.name: Direction
fields.evidence: operator= (+0x264970) copies 8 bytes at +4 and 4 at +0xC; SetOrthoType writes (0,-1,0), (0,0,1)... per type and adds it to the camera position to get the look-at target.

fields.name: MoveXInput
fields.evidence: OnInputOrthoCameraBehavior events 0x15/0x16; Update multiplies it by Speed and frame time and moves the camera along X (or Y, depending on Direction).

fields.name: MoveZInput
fields.evidence: OnInput events 0x17/0x18; Update moves along Z (or Y).

fields.name: ZoomInput
fields.evidence: OnInput events 0x1B/0x1C; Update: if non-zero, Size *= ZoomInput * 0.4 + 1.8.

fields.name: field_1C
fields.evidence: Constructor 0; copied by operator=; not read by the update/input functions opened.

fields.name: Speed
fields.evidence: Constructor 0x41200000 (10.0); Update multiplies the move inputs by it and by GameTime+8.

fields.name: OrthoType
fields.evidence: Toolkit accessor ls::OrthoCameraBehavior::GetOrthoType returns enum EOrthoType at +0x24; SetOrthoType stores 0, 1 or 2 (enum not declared in Script Extender; 4 bytes).
